about_the_game:
Its time time to go to war and what better way to prepare is in the colors of the of the ancient warriors of Sparta. Deck yourself out in style with this Federation Ship Sparta themed armor set!

Includes:

Sparta Armor Helmet Visor

Sparta Armor Uniform

Sparta HUD Nameplate

Sparta Player Banner

Sparta Helmet Decal

Sparta Weapon Skin

Sparta Medal

Sparta Nameplate Frame

Sparta Ribbon

Sparta Emblem
